contracts.boundary: After the v2 retirement the operator merge gate targets main: merge-controller's BASE_BRANCH default and the CLI --base default are main, merge-eligibility rejects PRs whose base branch is not main, the evidence-rebind CLI default base ref is origin/main, and the documented operator example shows the main base. Every base-branch discriminator in the fixtures stays a genuine mutation: the wrong-base rejection uses a branch name that differs from the default, the dependency-integration gate rejects a foreign base branch, and final revalidation distinguishes a moved base by both sha and ref name.
contracts.assertions: The generated wrong-base rejection test and the renamed dependency-integration test pin the main-targeting gate in the declared test files; the base-movement revalidation test fails closed on a changed ref name even when the shas are unchanged; and the guard-removal controls prove the final-revalidation and receipt guards still turn red when disabled and pass when restored.

boundaryTest.name: rejects wrong PR base branch without invoking merge

invariant.name: final revalidation returns no blocker when head, base, and proposed identity are unchanged

fault.name: guard removal control: disabling final revalidation reddens the movement assertion, restore is green
